# Todoist for Personal Assistant Integration

## TL;DR

**Todoist is the right tool** for adding personal task management to an advisory PA
(Claude API + MCP). It has the best API, the only vendor-maintained MCP server, and a
data model built for personal tasks. Alternatives (Trello, TickTick, Microsoft To Do) are
weaker on API quality, MCP ecosystem, or data model fit.

| Decision | Choice |
|----------|--------|
| Tool | Todoist |
| MCP server | Official ([ai.todoist.net/mcp](https://ai.todoist.net/mcp)) or [greirson/mcp-todoist](https://github.com/greirson/mcp-todoist) (19 tools) |
| Auth | `data:read` OAuth scope (read-only) or personal API token |
| Tier | Pro (~$5/mo) for reminders + 150 filters |
| Polling | Sync API every 5-10 min |
| Deduplication | Filter out "Todoist" calendar events from Google Calendar reads |

## Alternatives Comparison

| | Todoist | Trello | TickTick | MS To Do |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| MCP stars | 409 + 187 | 287 | None | 49 (stale) |
| Auth setup | Minutes | Minutes | Medium | Hours (Azure AD) |
| Data model | Task lists | Kanban boards | Task lists | Basic lists |
| API quality | Excellent | Good | Limited | Complex |
| Price | ~$5/mo | ~$5/mo | ~$3/mo | Free |

## What the PA Surfaces

| Priority | Signal | Todoist Filter |
|----------|--------|---------------|
| High | Overdue personal tasks | `overdue` |
| High | Today's personal tasks | `today` |
| High | Urgent items due soon | `p1 & 7 days` |
| Medium | Upcoming deadlines | `7 days` |
| Low | Recurring tasks due | `today & recurring` |

## Quick Decision Framework

1. **Already using Todoist?** → Add the MCP server and connect to your PA
2. **Need personal task tracking in PA?** → Get Todoist Pro, add MCP server
3. **Prefer kanban/visual boards?** → Trello works but is weaker for task management
4. **Deep in Microsoft ecosystem?** → Microsoft To Do is free but complex to integrate
5. **Want habit tracking?** → TickTick has it, but the API is too limited for PA use
